verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a usage-based billing platform, since some products in this category ship open-source cores, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Metronome's source is published under an open license. The SDK mention (metronome-docs-16) gives no license or source-availability detail, and the community remark about being 'open' refers to candor about pricing complexity, not source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
